name: Mei-chan no Kyuujitsu
source:
An ADV game inspired by Gyakuten Saiban (Ace Attorney) starring Franziska von Karma
Choices will affect which man violates her. 

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138914.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款受《逆轉裁判》啟發、以狩魔冥為主角的ADV遊戲。
你的選擇將決定她被哪個男人侵犯。
